answers.workaround: This is for the Godot Docs, not the editor or engine itself. [Reading the GDScript docs and hand-translating them to C# seems to be the current official "solution"](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/c_sharp/c_sharp_differences.html#c-api-differences-to-gdscript), but may feel daunting and unnecessary to newcomers. Godot itself presents C# as almost as much of a "main" language as GDScript, and a lot of people come to Godot solely planning to use C#.

title: Add toggle to documentation for C# API, such as PascalCase method names
